title: Unveiling the therapeutic potential of Ziziphus jujuba against breast cancer: A network pharmacology and Invitro validation.
authors: Pushbaraj, Santhia; Muthu Kumaradoss, Mohan Maruga Raja; Muthu Kumaradoss, Kathiravan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络药理学和分子对接探讨枣活性成分对乳腺癌的靶点作用，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Breast cancer is the second most common cancer among women worldwide, highlighting the need for safer and more effective treatments. Ziziphus jujuba, known for its rich bioactive compounds, shows promise, but its precise mechanisms in breast cancer are not fully understood. This study used an integrated approach combining network pharmacology, gene expression profiling, molecular docking simulations, and in vitro assays to investigate the therapeutic potential of Z. jujuba and its active flavonoid, spinosin. A total of 202 target genes were identified, with AKT1 and TP53 as central nodes enriched in the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway. Gene expression analysis revealed that TP53 was significantly overexpressed in breast cancer tissues, while AKT1 showed a non-significant trend towards elevated expression. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinities of spinosin to AKT1 (-7.72 kcal/mol) and TP53 (-6.27 kcal/mol). In vitro MTT assays demonstrated that spinosin reduced MCF-7 cell viability with an LC(50) of 101.945 mug/mL and induced 21.40 % total apoptosis, mainly in the late apoptotic phase. In contrast, doxorubicin, used as the positive control, demonstrated greater efficacy with an LC(50) of 8.81 mug/mL and induced a higher level of early-stage apoptosis (31.35 %). The inclusion of doxorubicin strengthens the experimental model, while the findings support spinosin as a natural, multi-targeted anti-cancer agent that acts through AKT1 and TP53 to reduce cell viability and induce apoptosis. Further experimental research, including in vivo validation, is necessary to validate these findings and clarify the underlying mechanisms of spinosin and Z. jujuba in cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌是全球女性中第二常见的癌症，凸显了对更安全、更有效治疗的需求。枣（Ziziphus jujuba）以其丰富的生物活性化合物而闻名，显示出潜力，但其在乳腺癌中的确切机制尚未完全明了。本研究采用整合方法，结合网络药理学、基因表达谱分析、分子对接模拟和体外实验，探讨枣及其活性黄酮类化合物斯皮诺素（spinosin）的治疗潜力。共鉴定出202个靶基因，其中AKT1和TP53作为富集于PI3K-Akt信号通路中的核心节点。基因表达分析显示，TP53在乳腺癌组织中显著过表达，而AKT1则表现出不显著的高表达趋势。分子对接揭示斯皮诺素与AKT1（-7.72 kcal/mol）和TP53（-6.27 kcal/mol）具有强结合亲和力。体外MTT实验表明，斯皮诺素降低MCF-7细胞活力，其LC(50)为101.945 μg/mL，并诱导21.40%的总凋亡，主要发生在晚期凋亡阶段。相比之下，作为阳性对照的阿霉素（doxorubicin）表现出更高的疗效，其LC(50)为8.81 μg/mL，并诱导更高水平的早期凋亡（31.35%）。阿霉素的纳入增强了实验模型，而研究结果支持斯皮诺素作为一种天然的、多靶点抗癌剂，通过AKT1和TP53发挥作用，降低细胞活力并诱导凋亡。进一步的实验研究，包括体内验证，对于确认这些发现并阐明斯皮诺素和枣在癌症治疗中的潜在机制是必要的。
